screens.name: Home — default, transition and omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show the dominant gold orb, empty/populated omen and consistent transition composition; supplied browser evidence reports enlargement and navigation clearance.
findings: Increase the sample-question whisper’s visibility and strengthen the orb’s actionable cue without competing with the illustration.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 1 shows a stable opening composition with a close control and next-step explanation; supplied motion evidence reports immediate approach under reduced motion.
findings: Make completion of the opening stage perceptible without relying on the changing orb.

screens.name: Ask — focused question, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 1 and 3 show labeled question entry and a distinct submission action, while supplied form evidence reports retained drafts and reachable submission at enlarged sizes.
findings: Reduce excess question-field height when content is short to bring submission closer at 200% text.

screens.name: Ask — collapsed named-person question and reader composer
screens.evidence: Sheets 2 and 20 show the named subject, question and submission hierarchy at both text sizes, with supplied evidence reporting complete question retention.
findings: Give the borderless question a clearer editing affordance so it does not resemble static forecast text.

screens.name: Named-person editor — normal, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 1–3 show explicit subject selection, first-name entry and save/cancel actions; supplied evidence reports validation and identity/draft preservation.
findings: Separate the first-name label from the focus outline so their proximity does not weaken the field’s visual grouping.

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 3–4 show consistent question, progress and four-choice structure across transition and settled captures.
findings: Clarify that choosing an answer advances the flow, especially before the first selection.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 4 shows stable spacing, explicit 2-of-3 progress and clearly separated answer rows.
findings: Provide a perceptible selected-answer acknowledgment before advancing to the next card.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 4–5 show the final card with consistent progress, answer spacing and a free-text alternative.
findings: Signal that the final choice starts forecast preparation so the next loading stage is expected.

screens.name: Other answer — empty, disabled, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 5 shows a labeled text field, disabled Continue and adjacent instructions at both sizes, with supplied form evidence reporting submission and return handling.
findings: Give the enlarged progress and Back to choices controls more separation in the top row.

screens.name: Planning — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 explains the current stage, possible wait and credit policy, while supplied evidence reports cancellation, timeout recovery and reduced-motion handling.
findings: Verify that the stage and any extended wait are announced accessibly without repeated ambient announcements.

screens.name: Research — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 shows research-specific supporting copy and cancellation beneath a large orb, with visibly stronger background mist than planning.
findings: Quiet the mist behind supporting text so loading stages preserve the same reading calm.

screens.name: Listening — voice failure and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 places microphone failure beside typing and retry controls, and supplied browser evidence reports voice fallback recovery.
findings: Make the failure state more prominent than the generic invitation to ask a question.

screens.name: Plan error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 6–7 show retry, question editing and no-charge reassurance beneath the illustrated error heading.
findings: Reduce the error orb’s prominence so the explanation and recovery action lead.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 7 adds answer review to retry and question editing, with supplied runtime evidence reporting successful retry without credit loss.
findings: Explain when reviewing answers is useful so the two secondary recovery paths are easier to choose between.

screens.name: Sensitive plan redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 24 presents support, alternative-question and editing actions with an explicit no-reading-spent notice.
findings: Place the brief explanation before the support button to establish why that action is appropriate.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 retain the same support and recovery hierarchy after prediction, and supplied evidence reports the sensitive redirect boundary.
findings: Clarify the support destination before activation while keeping the no-charge reassurance close.

screens.name: Reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show a large forecast, smaller speculative qualification, readable check-back date and several follow-up actions.
findings: Strengthen the qualification relative to the categorical headline and simplify the cluster of follow-up actions.

screens.name: Check-in — unanswered and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 6 shows outcome choices below the forecast while Share remains the visually dominant button.
findings: Give the outcome task stronger local emphasis so sharing does not overshadow the purpose of check-in.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Yes
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows a selected Yes and one local Saved status, with supplied evidence reporting persisted outcomes.
findings: Increase the saved-status emphasis enough to confirm completion without competing with the forecast.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Not quite
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows a checkmarked Not quite and matching persistent saved feedback.
findings: Use the same outcome wording in the prompt, selected choice and saved status to reduce interpretation.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Not yet
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows a selected Not yet and saved pending status, with supplied evidence reporting persistence.
findings: Explain whether Not yet changes the next check-in date or simply records the current outcome.

screens.name: Evidence overview — settled, transition and 200% reader
screens.evidence: Sheets 20 and 22 show distinct evidence categories with counts and descriptions, and supplied browser evidence reports full readers, focus return and contrast checks.
findings: Preserve the category descriptions and counts when expanding evidence content.

screens.name: Evidence answers — settled, transition and 100%/200% readers
screens.evidence: Sheets 7–8 and 19 show long answer sections, scalable text and visible heading focus, with supplied evidence reporting lossless prose and reader navigation.
findings: Use meaningful question headings to make long answer sections easier to scan than the illustrated context labels.

screens.name: Evidence assumptions — settled, transition and 100%/200% readers
screens.evidence: Sheets 8 and 19 show a focused single-topic reader with explicit qualification and return navigation, supported by supplied reader and contrast checks.
findings: Preserve this restrained single-topic layout when replacing stress fixtures with complete assumptions.

screens.name: Evidence reason — settled, transition and 100%/200% readers
screens.evidence: Sheets 8–9 and 21 show separated prose blocks with scalable heading focus and a return action, while supplied evidence reports complete text retention.
findings: Label the context, interpretation and limitation blocks to distinguish their roles during scanning.

screens.name: Evidence sources — settled, transition and 100%/200% readers
screens.evidence: Sheets 9 and 21 clearly qualify sources as background and show dates and external links, with supplied reader evidence covering text scaling and contrast.
findings: Give each source a concise, prominent title so long summaries do not bury its identity and link.

screens.name: Free Why this forecast — settled, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 shows a visible return path and scalable explanation, with supplied evidence reporting free/Plus reader boundaries and focus return.
findings: Add short semantic subheadings to make the explanation’s distinct claims easier to navigate.

screens.name: History — empty and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a clear empty-state message, local-storage disclosure and Ask the Ball action above persistent navigation.
findings: Give the empty-state action stronger button-like emphasis for first-time users.

screens.name: History — populated and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 distinguishes date, original question, forecast and readable check-back date within a single saved row.
findings: Add a restrained open-detail affordance so a saved reading clearly reads as interactive.

screens.name: History — stress list and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show multiple separated readings and a persisted Came true label, with supplied runtime evidence reporting history/outcome persistence.
findings: Keep outcome status in a consistent location across rows to improve scanning of a longer history.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples, selected question and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 27 explicitly marks offline samples, exposes Retry and shows a selected star with a corresponding question and action.
findings: Strengthen the relationship between the selected star and question panel beyond the small gold checkmark.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 6 shows an offline notice, retry, disabled creation and unavailable eligibility, while supplied evidence distinguishes separate adapter tests from the main preview.
findings: Consolidate the introductory circle copy so the offline state and recovery path are easier to scan.

screens.name: Age confirmation — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 presents explicit age choices and no-birthday reassurance, with supplied evidence reporting acceptance, decline and reload behavior.
findings: Demonstrate this initial confirmation at 200% text as well as the subsequent blocked and correction screens.

screens.name: Onboarding birthday — settled, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show labeled optional date parts, an example and skip action, with supplied evidence reporting validation and enlarged-field behavior.
findings: Reduce vertical overhead in the enlarged date form so its optional skip and continue choices are discovered sooner.

screens.name: Onboarding age blocked — settled, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 clearly states the age boundary and correction path at both sizes, with supplied browser evidence reporting no bypass and focus handling.
findings: Preserve the direct explanation and single correction path.

screens.name: Onboarding birthday correction — settled, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows the mandatory correction form and return path, with supplied browser evidence reporting validation, save, cancel and reload.
findings: Keep the correction action closer to enlarged date fields by tightening nonessential vertical spacing.

screens.name: Onboarding focus — unselected and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows four focus choices and copy permitting skipping, with Meet the Ball as the only forward action.
findings: Make the unselected forward action explicitly communicate that it continues without choosing a focus.

screens.name: Onboarding focus — selected, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show selected focus through color, checkmark and underline, with enlarged content and supplied focus-update evidence.
findings: Verify initial scroll placement on entry at 200% so the partially shown heading is not an entry-state defect.

screens.name: Paywall — settled, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show selected yearly pricing, monthly and pack alternatives, plus repeated simulation labeling supported by supplied simulated-purchase evidence.
findings: Show the yearly total as the principal price and explicitly state yearly cancellation terms alongside the monthly comparison.

screens.name: Share — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 27 shows a centered preview, enlargement affordance, image dimensions and download action, with supplied evidence reporting actual PNG export.
findings: Increase preview text legibility so the qualification can be checked before opening the enlarged view.

screens.name: Share options — expanded and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 26 shows the preview, download action and expanded Invite & remind heading, but the expanded controls are below the capture.
findings: Include the expanded controls in review evidence so their hierarchy and available actions can be evaluated.

screens.name: Export — preparing/held
screens.evidence: Sheet 9 shows disabled download with Preparing image status, and supplied evidence reports one polite status, one encode and usable unrelated controls.
findings: Keep the status directly associated with the disabled action throughout encoding.

screens.name: Export — failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 explicitly labels Try download again and explains export failure, with supplied evidence reporting injected failure and a successful actual download.
findings: Retain the preview during recovery so retry does not suggest the reading itself was lost.

screens.name: Share inspection/story — settled, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 25–26 and 28 show full-width artwork and transcript entry, with supplied evidence reporting keyboard opening, exact accessible text and focus return.
findings: Make the transcript’s availability more apparent when the full-height artwork pushes it below the viewport.

screens.name: You — profile, memory and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 30 groups birth profile, plan and remembered focus with editing controls, while supplied runtime evidence reports memory editing and Undo.
findings: Give birth-profile actions less vertical weight so the memory section is easier to discover.

screens.name: You — settings controls and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows sound, motion and text switches with plan/privacy actions, supported by supplied keyboard, persistence and actual reduced-motion checks.
findings: Demonstrate focused controls scrolling clear of both fixed bars at 200%, where content is visibly cut at the viewport edges.

screens.name: You — birthday editor, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 29 shows populated date parts, save/cancel and removal disclosure, with supplied evidence reporting age validation and retention boundaries.
findings: Keep save and cancel discoverable after the enlarged year field without excessive scrolling.

screens.name: You — expanded birth details, transition and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 28–29 show optional local time and birth-city search, with supplied evidence reporting live geocoding and calculated chart results.
findings: Explain the time format in the enlarged layout and show the search-result selection state in subsequent visual evidence.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home uses a distinctive gold illustration while supporting screens reuse a cloudy orb, with supplied browser evidence reporting motion controls and drawing performance.
findings: Differentiate the actionable Home orb from decorative/loading instances through a clearer interaction cue.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main screens show labeled destinations, gold active styling and a raised central Ask orb; supplied target measurements report controls at least 44×44.
findings: Give enlarged labels more breathing room, particularly between Ask and History.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently place identity left and reading balance right, with balances wrapping to two lines at 200%.
findings: Reduce the enlarged balance’s visual competition with page titles while preserving its full wording.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons provide consistent emphasis across normal, disabled and retry states, with supplied browser evidence covering target size, focus and export activation handling.
findings: Preserve content-driven height for wrapped labels at 200%.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Secondary actions alternate between gold links and centered white rows across reveal, recovery and settings.
findings: Standardize secondary-action styling by purpose so navigation and state-changing actions are easier to distinguish.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Card choices use spacious full-width rows and quiet separators, but the supplied screenshots do not show their pressed or selected intermediate states.
findings: Demonstrate selection acknowledgment and the auto-advance behavior before assigning a premium interaction score.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: The question uses display-serif text with a gold focus outline and a borderless resting state, supported by supplied draft-retention evidence.
findings: Strengthen the resting edit affordance and simplify the nested outline/underline treatment.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged question, person and date fields visibly reflow, with supplied evidence reporting exact doubling and form reachability in constrained browser viewports.
findings: Reduce nonessential spacing around enlarged fields while preserving readable text and target sizes.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 25 shows labeled switches with distinct thumb position and active color, supported by supplied keyboard, storage and actual motion-stop evidence.
findings: Preserve both positional and color state cues.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show populated and empty daily omen content beneath the Home orb.
findings: Clarify whether No omen today is an expected daily state or unavailable content.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 27 links a checkmarked Love star to a sample question and primary action.
findings: Make the selected star visually more distinct from the decorative stars and related topic markers.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 6 explicitly distinguishes offline creation and eligibility while describing the limited shared information.
findings: Shorten repeated introductory copy and prioritize offline recovery.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 separate original question, forecast, date and persisted outcome within borderless rows.
findings: Add a subtle disclosure cue to establish that the complete reading can be opened.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show checked yearly selection, a gold separator and clearly labeled simulated prices.
findings: Prioritize the actual billing amount and apply equivalent cancellation information to each subscription option.

components.name: Share preview and exported card
components.evidence: Sheets 25–28 show consistent artwork and explicit speculative qualification, with supplied evidence reporting actual PNG inspection and accessible transcript navigation.
findings: Improve small-preview qualification legibility while retaining the enlarged transcript alternative.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice, export, reading and offline states show contextual recovery, with supplied evidence reporting no credit loss and local polite feedback.
findings: Keep each failure explanation adjacent to the action that resolves it.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently pair expressive serif headings with sans-serif utility text, while enlarged layouts reveal long stacks and normal layouts retain small supporting labels.
findings: Tighten the display-type hierarchy and raise supporting text prominence where it carries qualification or task instructions.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and warm lower glow unify the sheets, with supplied evidence reporting sampled transition contrast and actual reduced-motion stopping.
findings: Reduce high-contrast mist behind dense reading and recovery content.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Date parts have persistent labels and an explicit example, with supplied browser evidence covering validation, scaling and storage preservation.
findings: Demonstrate numeric-keyboard entry and error association on a physical phone before extending the browser assessment.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheet 13 shows unambiguous age choices, while supplied evidence reports decline, reload and eligibility behavior.
findings: Add visual evidence of the confirmation choices at 200% text.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show selected and unselected choices, using a checkmark, gold text and underline together.
findings: Make continuing without a selection explicitly recognizable as skipping.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 28–30 clearly distinguish Sun sign, age band and readable birthday with edit and optional-detail actions.
findings: Compact the profile action rows to keep the next section visible sooner.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheets 28–29 show optional time and city fields with state-specific search instructions, while supplied evidence reports successful live lookup.
findings: Show selected-city confirmation and invalid-time feedback in visual evidence.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 1–3 distinguish self from someone else and show a named subject summary, supported by supplied identity-validation and cancellation evidence.
findings: Increase label-to-focus-outline separation in the first-name field.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 20 and 22 show descriptive category rows and counts, with supplied browser evidence reporting complete readers and keyboard focus return.
findings: Retain explicit category descriptions rather than relying on the atmospheric Behind the mist label alone.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheets 9–10 show preparing and failure states, supported by supplied evidence of one polite status, disabled duplicate activation and successful retry.
findings: Preserve the single inline status and explicit retry label.

components.name: Outcome selection and saved status
components.evidence: Sheet 17 shows all three selected outcomes with persistent local confirmation, and supplied evidence reports storage persistence.
findings: Explain pending-outcome consequences and give the check-in task stronger emphasis than sharing.

components.name: Reading progress indicator
components.evidence: Sheets 3–5 combine short progress segments with explicit step counts and retain counts in free-text entry.
findings: Keep progress and return controls visually separate when text enlarges.

components.name: Close and back controls
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use upper-left close/back glyphs, with supplied measurements reporting adequate rendered target bounds.
findings: Verify that each close action communicates its destination and preserves unfinished work where expected.

components.name: Forecast card and qualification
components.evidence: Reveal and shared-image screens pair a prominent forecast with much smaller speculative and non-guarantee language.
findings: Bring uncertainty closer to the headline’s visual prominence so the intended entertainment framing survives quick scanning.

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; no independent runtime inspection was performed.
Transition pairs support endpoint consistency but cannot independently establish animation continuity, timing or absence of intermediate layout shifts.
Reported browser checks support individual interaction scores; they do not establish repeated novice usability or exemplary outcomes.
Physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, native text scaling, keyboard behavior, microphone, haptics, actual payments and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Content continuing beyond the viewport is not treated as inaccessible solely from a screenshot; supplied scrolling/form evidence does not replace physical keyboard testing.
Expanded invite controls, birth-city result selection, several invalid-input states and successful live microphone capture are not visibly represented.
Synthetic long-content fixtures test layout rather than production wording, source credibility or predictive quality; no fixture wording is classified as a production-copy defect.
The main Circles preview is offline and Sky uses samples; separate adapter evidence does not certify production social infrastructure.
Null is used only for dimensions inapplicable to decorative or noninteractive components.

Using the frozen mean-and-weight formula, the all-items A>=9 and F>=9 browser threshold is not met; no hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence, and no full/native 9/10 certification is issued.
topFixes: Strengthen speculative qualification relative to forecast headlines across reveal and exported previews.
Clarify borderless interaction affordances for the Home orb, resting question, history rows and auto-advancing answers.
Reduce enlarged-form overhead so primary actions and optional skip paths are discovered sooner.
Add semantic subheadings and stronger source identities to long evidence readers.
Prioritize check-in and recovery tasks over sharing or decorative orb emphasis on those screens.
Quiet mist behind dense text and supply visual evidence for expanded invite controls, city selection and enlarged age confirmation.
